name: Witch King's Orchestra Conductor
desc: Conductor who was once the instrument of their king's will. Having been second only to one, and having gazed upon that elusive spire, he will go to any length to see it again.
abil: Continuously casts at the nearest Tuning Node you control within attack range to disable it
When the corresponding variation is in effect, greatly increases the max HP of all enemies within attack range

name: Delegation Recruit
desc: Soldier recruited into the delegation, employing the standard orthodox tactics. They are enjoying the peaceful lull.

name: Delegation Veteran
desc: Soldier whose fate is entwined with the delegation, employing hardened and ruthless tactics. They are on guard against potential escalation.

name: Delegation Assault Recruit
desc: New recruits on a special mission, firing warning shots with non-lethal weapons to avoid unnecessary loss of life. Having never seen war with their own eyes, they carry out their mission with expectations of peace.
abil: Attacks in areas deal Arts damage; attacks in Emergency Heater range deal Physical damage.

name: Delegation Assault Veteran
desc: Veteran on a special mission, firing warning shots with non-lethal weapons to avoid unnecessary loss of life. Having seen death with their own eyes, they respond to orders with the instinctive reactions of war.
abil: Attacks in areas deal Arts damage; attacks in Emergency Heater range deal Physical damage.

name: Clockwork Patroller
desc: Patrol machine developed for the local environment. Moves faster if it is wound up a few times before battle. Low firepower.
abil: Movement speed is reduced in Emergency Heater range.

name: Clockwork Warrior
desc: Patrol machine developed for the local environment. Moves faster if it is wound up a few times before battle. High firepower.
abil: Movement speed is reduced in Emergency Heater range.

name: Frozen Mountain Burdenbeast
desc: Mountain burdenbeast buried by a sudden avalanche. Its thick layer of fat will help it survive the worst of it until rescue arrives.
abil: Remains on standby in areas for a while without attacking.
Immediately revived if its plate is in Emergency Heater range

name: Slumbering Mountain Burdenbeast
desc: Mountain burdenbeast buried by familiar snowfall. It will rest well in its habitual hibernation until it senses the spring breeze.
abil: Remains on standby in areas for a while without attacking.
Immediately revived if its plate is in Emergency Heater range

name: 'Jet Canister'
desc: This weapon was developed for close-range assault in response to the painful experience of trench warfare, but how many would be willing to carry a such a heavy and fragile can on their backs?
abil: On death, deals Arts damage to all nearby units, inflicting Cold and disabling Emergency Heaters.

name: 'Boom Canister'
desc: After many broken and exploded cans, people came to the realization that this weapon needed someone with a death wish, making trench warfare even more painful.
abil: On death, deals Arts damage to all nearby units, inflicting Cold and disabling Emergency Heaters.

name: Delegation Caster
desc: Elite Arts attackers of the delegation, casting with perfect coordination, but still asked to take it easy.
abil: Attacks in areas deal splash damage in a cross; trait is inactive in Emergency Heater range.

name: Delegation Caster Commander
desc: Ferocious Arts attackers of the delegation, casting with resonant harmony, but still ordered to take it easy.
abil: Attacks in areas deal splash damage in a cross; trait is inactive in Emergency Heater range.

name: Delegation Shieldbearer
desc: Determined defenders of the delegation, their shields one with the frozen crystals, forming a wall on the snow that few can penetrate.
abil: DEF and RES gradually increase in areas, and gradually decrease in Emergency Heater range.

name: Delegation Shieldbearer Captain
desc: Outstanding defenders of the delegation, their form one with heaven and earth, forming an unbreakable wall in the snow.
abil: DEF and RES gradually increase in areas, and gradually decrease in Emergency Heater range.

name: 'Catapult'
desc: Expert grenadiers of the delegation, able to throw shells as heavy as a hundred kilos. The rest of the delegation knows better than to challenge them to a snowball fight.
abil: Throws a massive snowball, dealing splash damage in a cross
Can only use melee attacks once snowball is thrown

name: 'Mortar'
desc: Elite grenadiers of the delegation, able to throw shells with the same power as city artillery. No one in the delegation is foolish enough to challenge them, so they roam the snow with their carefully crafted balls, waiting for a challenger foolish enough to fall into their trap.
abil: Throws a massive snowball, dealing splash damage in a cross
Can only use melee attacks once snowball is thrown

name: Delegation Centurion
desc: Centurions are normally tasked with assaulting a fortified position. In the delegation, their main task is to defeat the defenders of the heaters.
abil: Invisible
Prioritizes targets to the right of a Emergency Heater

name: Delegation Centurion Champion
desc: If defeating heater defenders has become the focus of the delegation's training, then it is no surprise that a champion would eventually emerge.
abil: Invisible
Prioritizes targets to the right of a Emergency Heater

name: Filth
desc: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a poor harvest. They carry a crop-killing Blight, and pose a great risk to agricultural yields.
abil: Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

name: Expelled Filth
desc: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a failed harvest. They carry a wide range of crop-killing Blights, and pose a tremendous risk to agricultural yields.
abil: Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

name: Consumption
desc: A fabric construct that contaminates plants, capable of spraying Blight from a distance. Even crops on agricultural plates are at risk.
abil: When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal Arts damage

name: Banished Consumption
desc: A fabric construct that corrodes plants, capable of spraying highly hazardous Blight from a distance. Even well-protected crops on agricultural plates are at risk.
abil: When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal Arts damage

name: Scum
desc: A large fabric construct that uses its huge mass and thick skin to run rampant across the paddies, detested by farmers.
abil: More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

name: Accursed Scum
desc: A gargantuan fabric construct that uses its huge mass and nigh-impenetrable skin to wreak havoc across the paddies, loathed by farmers.
abil: More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

name: Blemish
desc: A fabric construct that spreads Blight across a wide area. If left unchecked, once fertile farmland will become a hotbed of blight in less than half a day.
abil: Absorbs shallow water to attack all allied melee units on the map, dealing splash damage in a cross
When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal additional Arts damage and causes Blight to the paddy

name: Renounced Blemish
desc: A fabric construct that ruthlessly spreads Blight across a wide area. If left unchecked, once fertile farmland will instantly become a farmer's worst nightmare.
abil: Absorbs shallow water to attack all allied melee units on the map, dealing splash damage in a cross
When on Blighted tiles, attacks deal additional Arts damage and causes Blight to the paddy

name: Miasma
desc: Similar to a stockbeast in appearance, seemingly docile at first glance. But unlike other fabric constructs, they become aggressive towards people after absorbing the Blight in the soil and water, so exercise caution.
abil: Rebirth
Regenerates itself on the spot when defeated, continuously absorbing any Blight it is in contact with and increasing DEF based on the amount absorbed; attacks now deal additional Arts damage

name: Basal Miasma
desc: Similar to a stockbeast in appearance, seemingly docile at first glance. But unlike other fabric constructs, they become very aggressive towards people after absorbing the Blight in the soil and water, so exercise the utmost caution.
abil: Rebirth
Regenerates itself on the spot when defeated, continuously absorbing any Blight it is in contact with and increasing DEF based on the amount absorbed; attacks now deal additional Arts damage

name: Fieldmus
desc: The fieldmus is the farmer's sworn enemy, as well as a living page from the annals of Terra's agricultural history. They have adapted to modern farming techniques, and even Throttle Valves cannot escape their destructive tendencies.
abil: Attacks surrounding Throttle Valves
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

name: Hard-Snouted Fieldmus
desc: The fieldmus is the farmer's sworn enemy, as well as a living page from the annals of Terra's agricultural history. They have fully adapted to modern farming techniques, and even the most advanced Throttle Valves cannot escape their destructive tendencies.
abil: Attacks surrounding Throttle Valves
Becomes Invisible on Blighted tiles

name: Fieldmus Bruiser
desc: The more bountiful the harvest, the fatter the fieldmus. When these creatures grow four-packs, even the Tianshis sigh—for they destroy Throttle Valves with frightening efficiency.
abil: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over

name: Fieldmus Ravager
desc: The more bountiful the harvest, the fatter the fieldmus. When these creatures grow eight-packs, even the Tianshis rub their aching brows—for they can do away with a Throttle Valve in the blink of an eye.
abil: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over

name: Fieldmus Flying Thief
desc: The thing with fieldmus is that not only do they ruin farm equipment, they also take the loose parts back to their lairs. Who knows, maybe they'll be able to build a nomadic city one day.
abil: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over
When defeated, grants a deployable unit

name: Fieldmus Heistmaster
desc: The thing with fieldmus is that not only do they dismantle farm equipment, they also leave no loose parts behind. Who knows, maybe they'll be able to build a nomadic city one day.
abil: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
Sprints upon taking damage, gaining greatly increased Movement Speed for a short time
Deals heavy damage to Throttle Valves it passes over
When defeated, grants a deployable unit

name: Sky Pole - Jia
desc: Structural pillar-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Jia. Capable of monitoring soil conditions, water source quality, and pest and Blight status in real time; during emergency situations, can release the corresponding Sky Pole Model Yi.
abil: Starts battle as a friendly unit, monitors the paddy's Blight level
Wakes up when the Blight level in the current paddy exceeds a certain threshold
Gradually loses HP. For every certain percentage of HP lost, releases a certain number of Sky Pole - Yi

name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Jia
desc: Structural pillar-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Jia. Originally capable of monitoring soil conditions, water source quality, and pest and Blight status in real time; during emergency situations, can release the corresponding Sky Pole Model Yi. However, it has now gone out of control.
abil: Starts battle as a friendly unit, monitors the paddy's Blight level
Wakes up when the Blight level in the current paddy exceeds a certain threshold
Gradually loses HP. For every certain percentage of HP lost, releases a certain number of Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi

name: Sky Pole - Yi
desc: UAV-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Yi. Capable of completing tasks within the signal range of Model Jia, such as collecting crop samples, eliminating pests, spraying pesticides, and driving away trespassing beasts.
abil: Latches onto the first unit within range and relentlessly attacks until the target is defeated

name: Out of Control Sky Pole - Yi
desc: UAV-type comprehensive monitoring-maintenance system on experimental plates, Sky Pole Model Yi. Originally capable of completing tasks within the signal range of Model Jia, such as collecting crop samples, eliminating pests, spraying pesticides, and driving away trespassing beasts. However, it has now gone out of control.
abil: Latches onto the first unit within range and relentlessly attacks until the target is defeated

name: Coalition Army Hound
desc: A hound trained by the Bolívar Coalition Army. Perro officers were not too enthused about this being introduced into their tactical considerations.

name: Coalition Army Hound Pro
desc: A hunting hound trained in Columbia and purchased by the Bolívarian Coalition government. The idea was met with some resistance within the army.

name: Armored Scout
desc: An armored scout. The armor they wear is capable of pinpointing the location of attackers.
abil: Exposes the attacker for 5s when attacked
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

name: Heavy Scout
desc: A heavily-armored scout. The Coalition Army has reinforced the armor, but has no clue how to upgrade the tracing function.
abil: Exposes the attacker for 5s when attacked
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

name: Light Rapid Crossbowman
desc: A light crossbowman who can fire three bolts at once. The price of such on-demand firepower is their weakness in long-time battles.
abil: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 3 bolts in the target's direction

name: Heavy Rapid Crossbowman
desc: A heavy crossbowman who can fire three bolts at once. The Columbian investigation team was forced to admit that these 'homemade gadgets' were just as powerful as some of the latest cutting-edge weaponry.
abil: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 3 bolts in the target's direction

name: Heavy Crossbowman Ambusher
desc: A sniper issued with a mass-produced kinetically-boosted crossbow. Though expensive, they are well worth the price tag, capable of stunning targets for long durations after being charged up.
abil: Invisible
Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 1 bolt in the target's direction that deals Arts damage and inflicts Stun

name: Heavy Crossbowman Hunter
desc: A sniper issued with a prototype kinetically-boosted crossbow. Exorbitantly expensive. It's said that the buyer reached a secret agreement with a small Columbian company.
abil: Invisible
Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 1 bolt in the target's direction that deals Arts damage and inflicts Stun

name: Reckless Grenadier
desc: A specialized combatant who does not carry conventional weapons. Though well-paid and exempted from standard military training, nobody envies them.
abil: Upon taking damage for the first time while unblocked, fires an explosive in each cardinal direction; afterwards, gains increased Movement Speed and reduced Weight

name: Impetuous Grenadier
desc: A specialized combatant whose fighting methods differ from the norm. The other soldiers call them cannon fodder, unaware that they are seen the exact same way by their superiors.
abil: Upon taking damage for the first time while unblocked, fires an explosive in each cardinal direction; afterwards, gains increased Movement Speed and reduced Weight

name: Battleline Advance Guard
desc: Heavily-armed personnel in charge of advancing the frontline. Typically made up of grumpy old veterans who take out their anger towards their superiors on anything standing in their way.
abil: Each time this unit is blocked, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased.

name: Battleline Breacher
desc: Heavily-armored personnel in charge of breaking through enemy lines. They only know how to swing their hammer, whether it's towards a roadblock or a living person.
abil: Each time this unit is blocked, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased.

name: Farseer
desc: An unmanned drone issued by Coalition Army. Though originally designed for reconnaissance, a circuitry issue made it unreliable at this, so an attack module was installed as a last resort.
abil: Flying unit.
When defeated, Exposes nearby allied units for 8s
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

name: Farseer B
desc: An unmanned drone modified by a Coalition veteran, who haphazardly adjusted the circuitry of the recon module before devoting the rest of his effort into boosting the firepower.
abil: Flying unit.
When defeated, Exposes nearby allied units for 8s
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

name: Battlefield Observing Mortarman
desc: A mortarman with keen senses, who fires shells embedded with reconnaissance units. An exceptional talent within the Coalition Army.
abil: Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles, and exposes targets for 5s
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

name: Battlefield Surveying Mortarman
desc: A mortarman with a wealth of experience, who fires shells embedded with reconnaissance units. It is said that two military leaders once even fought to claim a senior mortarman.
abil: Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles, and exposes targets for 5s
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

name: Mateo's Security Guard
desc: Mateo's security guard. Every Coalition Army leader needs people like these, or they wouldn't be able to sleep well at night.
abil: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 2 explosives in the target's direction
When unblocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced

name: Mateo's Guard
desc: Mateo's guard. Certain Coalition Army leaders have cultivated such individuals, leading them to feel that they are above their peers.
abil: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 2 explosives in the target's direction
When unblocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced

name: Mateo's Bodyguard
desc: Mateo's most trusted bodyguard. Very few military leaders have such individuals around them, but they often fail to appreciate how precious such loyalty really is.
abil: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 2 explosives in the target's direction
When unblocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced
Replenishes all ammo for upon approaching him

name: 'Flying Boots' Mercenary
desc: Propelled by compressed air cans beneath their feet, 'Flying Boots' mercenaries raid and plunder on the winds.
abil: Capable of evading physical attacks. Loses Physical Dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.

name: 'Flying Boots' Elite Mercenary
desc: Mercenaries propelled by compressed air cans beneath their feet. Their favorite targets are Ursus convoys and their simple, durable Ursine products.
abil: Capable of evading physical attacks. Loses Physical Dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.

name: 'Pothelm' Marksman
desc: Mercenaries with a Victorian lens on their helms. Thanks to how well their helms block out sound, they have never heard the snickers of other Scar Market mercs behind their backs.

name: 'Pothelm' Arbalest
desc: Well-equipped mercenaries with a Victorian lens on their helms. Thanks to how well their helms block out sound, they have never heard the snickers of other Scar Market mercs behind their backs.

name: Scrap Assembler
desc: Mercenaries fascinated with building new equipment and moving heavier equipment by adding more power.
abil: Temporarily takes flight when blocked or facing a Stabilizer Chain for the first time. DEF is greatly reduced after landing.

name: Scrap Inventor
desc: Inventors who have built a lot of new equipment, but have yet to finish design work on devices for flying and landing.
abil: Temporarily takes flight when blocked or facing a Stabilizer Chain for the first time. DEF is greatly reduced after landing.

name: Bounty Hunter 'Knight'
desc: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, equipped with self-made gear inspired by Kazimierzian knights. They take pleasure in tormenting their targets during missions.
abil: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

name: Bounty Hunter 'Grand Knight'
desc: Bounty hunters skilled in witchcraft, aspiring to join the Kazimierzian knight competitions once they've saved enough money. For now, their greatest joy remains tormenting their targets as they hunt them down.
abil: Accelerates when moving. First attack after being blocked deals extra Arts damage based on movement speed.

name: Spatula Giant
desc: Mercenaries are adept at building makeshift weapons from whatever is available. This massive, sputtering machine shambles forward, brandishing Lateran kitchen utensils while leaking fuel.
abil: Unblockable
Loses a percentage of HP over time against a Stabilizer Chain.

name: Enraged Spatula Giant
desc: Mercenaries are adept at building makeshift weapons from whatever is available. This massive, sputtering machine shambles forward, seeking to dice and slice with Lateran kitchen utensils.
abil: Unblockable
Loses a percentage of HP over time against a Stabilizer Chain.

name: Armored Burdenbeast
desc: Large, slow, and docile, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.
abil: Will be tripped by a Stabilizer Chain, stunning itself and dealing Physical damage to nearby enemies.

name: Greater Armored Burdenbeast
desc: Slow, docile, and even larger, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.
abil: Will be tripped by a Stabilizer Chain, stunning itself and dealing Physical damage to nearby enemies.

name: 'Shearclaws'
desc: Mercenaries wielding sharp blades as their weapons. Prone to injuring both friend and foe, they struggle to find companions.
abil: Attacks also deal splash damage to allied units in 4 adjacent tiles.
Cuts Stabilizer Chains.

name: 'Weaver'
desc: Mercenaries who expertly wield the latest equipment. Their mastery of the blades is so deep that they can operate a loom with them.
abil: Attacks also deal splash damage to allied units in 4 adjacent tiles.
Cuts Stabilizer Chains.

name: Rogue Mercenary 'Bass'
desc: Agitated rhythms and intense rumbling form the melody of the nomadic city of Kazdel. The members of this metal band have transformed their weapons into musical instruments, blending their dual roles as mercenaries and musicians.
abil: Targets one of your units, continuously dealing Arts and Burn to the target and all Operators connected to that unit by Stabilizer Chains.

name: Rogue Mercenary 'Lead Guitar'
desc: Metal band members who seamlessly blend their mercenary and performer careers. Their torrential rhythms are powerful enough to melt faces—literally.
abil: Targets one of your units, continuously dealing Arts and Burn to the target and all Operators connected to that unit by Stabilizer Chains.

name: 'Tinkerer'
desc: Sarkaz artificers obsessed with building a flying machine. The patches on the balloon mend not just the vehicle, but the heart of a dreamer as well.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Attack range reduced when it loses Low-Altitude Hovering.

name: 'Mechanic'
desc: Sarkaz artificers who have finally invented a working flying machine, perhaps the predecessor to far more powerful war machines in the distant future.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Attack range reduced when it loses Low-Altitude Hovering.

name: Deathveil Assassin
desc: Sarkaz assassins who have abandoned their names and cut off their horns. Behind their pall is a burning fanaticism and a destined fate.
abil: Invisible; the next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage.
Has Arts and Physical dodge.
Temporarily loses Invisibility, Physical dodge, and Arts dodge against a Stabilizer Chain.
Can pass through a blocking unit once when HP drops to below 50%.

name: Theresa, King of Sarkaz
desc: A humble hero, a radiant dream. The future converges in her gaze, while the path fades beneath her steps.
abil: [Eternal Dust] Several Particles orbit this unit, dealing True damage and causing knockback when they collide with an enemy.

name: Sarkaz Wither Vanguard
desc: Elites of the Nachzehrer King's armies, adept in Originium-rich environments. They draw power from Originium dust and fight until death claims them as nutrients for their comrades.
abil: Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.

name: Elite Sarkaz Wither Vanguard
desc: Elite commanders of the Nachzehrer King's armies, adept with extreme Originium-rich environments. Originium dust sharpens their blades as they slaughter their foes, until death comes. With each commander fallen, the legion advances in great strides.
abil: Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.

name: Sarkaz Wither Bulwark
desc: Veteran guards of the Nachzehrer King's legions. Martyrs who advance to certain death knowing that others will carry their blood soaked shield.

name: Sarkaz Wither Aegis
desc: Elite guards of the Nachzehrer King's legions. The aegis of hatred and war is a role of ultimate protection and sacrifice.

name: Caustic Originium Slug
desc: Mutated Originium slugs around Londinium, altered by the rapidly changing environment. Filled with dangerous Originium particulates, their bodies explode upon death, spreading active Originium pollution.
abil: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and causes Originium pollution.
Increases the strength of an Active Originium Storm when consumed by it.

name: Caustic Originium Slug α
desc: Highly mutated Originium slugs around Londinium, altered by the rapidly changing environment. Filled with extremely dangerous Originium particulates, their bodies explode upon death, spreading active Originium pollution.
abil: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and causes Originium pollution.
Increases the strength of an Active Originium Storm when consumed by it.

name: Profane Chimera
desc: A twisted creation of the Confessarii, this bio-weapon combines multiple pure Sarkaz bloodlines. Originium dust clings to its body, spreading as it flaps its great wings while moving.
abil: Continuously causes an area of Originium pollution around itself when affected by Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, and attacks deal Arts damage instead.

name: Sacrilegious Chimera
desc: The twisted masterpiece of the Confessarii, this bio-weapon combines multiple pure Sarkaz bloodlines. Originium dust clings to its body, which it spreads along with its endless fury wherever it treads by flapping its great wings.
abil: Continuously causes an area of Originium pollution around itself when affected by Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, and attacks deal Arts damage instead.

name: Sarkaz Altar Keeper
desc: Engineer casters of the Nachzehrer legion. They set their altars on the battlefield, like nails upon a carpet woven from war. Wherever they go, the storm of suffering will soon follow.
abil: Unblockable and has reduced movement speed when taking damage.
Picks up nearby Beacons if it is not carrying a Beacon, and drops them on death.

name: Sarkaz Altar Nourisher
desc: Veteran engineer casters of the Nachzehrer legion whose deaths nourish the altars they carry, like leaves upon the barren soil. Their deaths bring forth the promise of suffering.
abil: Unblockable and has reduced movement speed when taking damage.
Picks up nearby Beacons if it is not carrying a Beacon, and drops them on death.

name: Sudaram
desc: The Sudaram is the shroud of the dead. Once gaunt from hunger, it is now nourished by the power of the Nachzehrer King. For the Nachzehrer, consumption and nourishment—greed and devotion—are just two sides of the same dreaded coin.
abil: Attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding units.
When inside Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding allied units and all your units inside Originium pollution or Active Originium Storms.

name: Putrefied Sudaram
desc: The Putrefied Sudaram is the shroud of the fallen. Once bloated from gluttony, it now nourishes its insatiable kin. For the Nachzehrer, consumption and nourishment—greed and devotion—are just two sides of the same dreaded coin.
abil: Attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding units.
When inside Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding allied units and all your units inside Originium pollution or Active Originium Storms.

name: Soul Maelstrom
desc: Soul fragments born of a revenant's will. Innumerable emotions intertwine within—millennia of confused memories converging into a tangible maelstrom.

name: Focused Soul Remnant
desc: Soul remnant born of a revenant's will. As it absorbs the roving maelstroms, it releases turbulent witchcraft and emotions that impale enemies both in front and behind.
abil: Attacks deal Arts damage. Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends all Soul Maelstroms to deal continuous Arts damage to the target and all your units in a line.

name: Prism Soul Remnant
desc: Powerful soul remnant born of a revenant's will. As it absorbs roving maelstroms, it releases violent witchcraft and emotions that impale enemies both in front and behind.
abil: Attacks deal Arts damage. Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends all Soul Maelstroms to deal continuous Arts damage to the target and all your units in a line.

name: Chalice of Regret
desc: Soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with regret unfathomable. The past, tormenting yet unchangeable, is the cruelest cut.
abil: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

name: Chalice of Mortality
desc: Greater soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with conviction immeasurable. The future, unforeseen but destined, is the ultimate verdict.
abil: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

name: Infused Soul Husk
desc: Soul husk born of a revenant's will, imbued with the techniques of countless heroes in its memories. The heroes have all but fallen, leaving behind only indistinct silhouettes as memories.
abil: Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends Soul Maelstrom to summon an orbiting soul orb that deals heavy Arts damage to your units that collide into it.

name: Penumbral Soul Husk
desc: Powerful soul husk born of a revenant's will, imbued with the techniques of countless heroes in its memories. The heroes have all but fallen, but their silhouettes grow clearly through repeated remembrance.
abil: Can pick up and retain up to 3 Soul Maelstroms.
When carrying a Soul Maelstrom, expends Soul Maelstrom to summon an orbiting soul orb that deals heavy Arts damage to your units that collide into it.

name: Unicellular Predator
desc: A simple Seaborn believed to be responsible for foraging. It requires very little energy for its activities.

name: Allotropic Predator
desc: Simple but nourished, this new generation of Seaborn collects nutrients even more efficiently.

name: Exocellular Depositor
desc: A simple Seaborn that accumulates a large amount of chitin to form an excrescent carapace.
abil: Spawns an Excrescent Carapace at its location when defeated.
More likely to be attacked by allied units

name: Toxocellular Drifter
desc: A Seaborn with a highly developed cytostome, believed to be responsible for transportation. Shoots venomous cilia to protect itself.
abil: Flying unit.
Prioritizes units on High Ground.
Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.

name: Allotropic Drifter
desc: A Seaborn nourished in the migration process, possessing more energy for evolution or self-protection.
abil: Flying unit.
Prioritizes units on High Ground.
Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.

name: Divicellular Hoarder
desc: A Seaborn highly attuned to its environment, believed to be responsible for stockpiling resources. May split at any time when under stress.
abil: Splits when HP drops below 50% for the first time.

name: Allotropic Hoarder
desc: A Divicellular Hoarder that has stockpiled excessive nutrients, capable of responding to intense stimuli.
abil: Splits when HP drops below 50% for the first time.

name: Matrocellular Nurse
desc: A complex Seaborn with a variety of organs, believed to be responsible for brood care. Its core is concealed within its body.
abil: On death, randomly releases a , , or with increased Movement Speed.

name: Allotropic Nurse
desc: A complex Seaborn that has nurtured countless broods. Its specialized organs have developed into esoteric shapes. Its core is concealed even deeper, and the Seaborn it fosters are even more dangerous.
abil: On death, randomly releases an , , or with increased Movement Speed.

desc: Highly differentiated Seaborn with specialized tentacles that have proliferated across the ocean. Numbering in the billions, they are believed to shape ocean currents when they wave their tentacles.

name: Allotropic Herald
desc: Seaborn that have grown in nutrient-rich environments. In sufficient numbers, they can influence tidal movements and even trigger tsunamis.
abil: Can devour an Excrescent Carapace to significantly increase its ATK and HP.

name: Nucleic Maleficent
desc: A cell originally meant to develop into a specialized organ has mutated into an individual entity capable of metabolizing body waste into neurotoxin. Its role within the Seaborn population remains unclear.
abil: Becomes Combat-Ready when damaged, significantly increasing Movement Speed and continuously inflicting Nervous Impairment on nearby units.
Destroys blocking at the cost of a percentage of its HP.

name: Allotropic Maleficent
desc: Nucleic Maleficents that have survived in harsh environments, developing glands that produce neurotoxin. Extremely rare, and extremely dangerous.
abil: Becomes Combat-Ready when damaged, significantly increasing Movement Speed and continuously inflicting Nervous Impairment on nearby units.
Destroys blocking at the cost of a percentage of its HP.

name: 'The Abandoned'
desc: Their consciousness is almost gone. Every nerve strand cries out soundlessly: 'Free... pain...'
abil: Attacks deal Arts splash damage
Loses splash damage when blocked.

name: 'The Cursed'
desc: Their consciousness is fully gone. Every cell remembers the command: 'Dominate... ocean...'
abil: Attacks deal Arts splash damage
Loses splash damage when blocked.

name: Basic Slug
desc: An Originium slug raised in captivity. Has a relatively low infection rate and a rather ordinary taste. Its anatomical structure is different from that of wild slugs.
abil: Flees when HP is under 50%! Gains bonus Movement Speed and cannot be blocked for a period of time.

name: Gourmet Slug
desc: A free-range Originium slug raised with care, though it still retains a fierce streak. The quality of its meat hasn't improved much either. Requires a complex process to make edible.
abil: Flees when HP is under 50%! Gains bonus Movement Speed and cannot be blocked for a period of time.

name: Berry Slug

abil: Releases a blinding gleam upon taking damage, stunning surrounding allies for an extended period before attempting to escape via digging.
Drops if defeated before escaping.

name: Fruit Slug

abil: Releases a blinding gleam upon taking damage, stunning surrounding allies for an extended period before attempting to escape via digging.
Drops if defeated before escaping.

name: Raging Slug Eater

abil: Devours a surrounding unit but requires an extended period to digest on the spot before devouring again.

name: Raging Man Eater

abil: Devours a surrounding unit but requires an extended period to digest on the spot before devouring again.

name: Berry Metal Crab

name: 'Ink Brew'

abil: Non-Leader enemies passing by this enemy gain bonus ASPD and Movement Speed, and take less Physical and Arts damage.

name: Roaming Street Hunter

name: 'Sated'
desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a vessel for holding the five grains. The five grains are fundamental to sating hunger, and the vessel that stores them is appropriately solid and heavy.
abil: More likely to be attacked

name: 'Bloated'
desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a hardened vessel for holding the five grains. The five grains are fundamental to sating hunger, and the vessel that stores them must not only be solid and heavy, but also exceptionally tough.
abil: More likely to be attacked

name: Expletive
desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a broken clay pot. The dinner table has always been a place for petty squabbles, and the clay pot is hardly the only thing that gets broken.
abil: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack

name: Profanity
desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a clay pot that broke someone's skull, itself undamaged. The dinner table has always been a place for squabbles. Tables are flipped and pots are broken, but in the end, everyone might still have to sit back down and eat together.
abil: Can use long-ranged weapons to attack

name: Boiling Pot
desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.
abil: Continuously inflicts Arts damage and Burn to its surroundings
Immune to Slow

name: Drifting Aroma
desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, add some burdenbeast tallow, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.
abil: Continuously inflicts Arts damage and Burn to its surroundings
Immune to Slow

desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Life is always easier when there is spare meat and grain in the kitchen. Those who have known hardship always keep something in stock for a rainy day.

abil: Cannot be blocked.

abil: Pulls 1 within range towards itself, causing it to lose HP proportionate to distance moved when shifted

name: Reminiscence
desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Originally a common water pot, it was not discarded even after its original purpose had become obsolete, being passed down through the family as a storage pot. Reach inside, and one can often find trinkets thought lost.

Starts on standby

name: Wealth
desc: Abomination born of the people's longing for a better life. Approach it carelessly, and copper coins will come at you in a way that you did not bargain for.
abil: Spits copper coins to deal heavy damage at long range; Uses only melee attacks when out of coins
Can absorb nearby or to regain 1 copper coin

name: Prosperity
desc: Abomination born of the people's longing for a better life. Approach it carelessly, and gold coins will come at you in a way that you did not bargain for.
abil: Spits gold coins to deal heavy damage at long range; Uses only melee attacks when out of coins
Can absorb nearby or to regain 1 gold coin

name: Sapidity
desc: Spirit born of the meals people cook every day. Everything picked up by the chopsticks—joy or sorrow, mirth or anger—is a slice of life.

desc: Abomination born of the meals people discard. Put down the cup and lay aside the chopsticks. All is meaningless, and the meal on the plate vapid.
abil: Unblockable; Moves towards and can be absorbed by them, increasing their SP
Must be damaged 15 times to defeat; Spawns 1 when defeated
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter; Automatically moves towards

name: 'Sapid Auspice'
desc: Abomination born of a convergence of Sapidity. Likes to hover over places where many gather, an auspicious symbol that drives out illness and keeps disaster away.
abil: Deals True damage to all enemy units in its path
Cannot be attacked, does not count towards the defeated enemies counter, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field

name: 'Vapid Blight'
desc: Abomination born of a convergence of Vapidity. Likes to hover over places that are barren and broken, a symbol of misfortune.
abil: Deals True damage to all allied units in its path
Cannot be attacked, does not count towards the defeated enemies counter, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field

name: Patrolling Foliage
desc: Withered stump possessed by a fae spirit. Not yet able to protect others, it roams only to protect its own dwelling. Reveals its true form when approached.
abil: Their true nature is revealed when inside the attack range of your units

name: Patrolling Witherbush
desc: Withered stump that has merged with a fae spirit. Serving as a guard for the Dark Woods, it is armed and always vigilant. Reveals its true form when approached.
abil: Their true nature is revealed when inside the attack range of your units

name: Cabbage Seedling
desc: A small, common fae, the original form of Patrolling Foliage. Completely harmless if separated from fire.
abil: Can be ignited by or
When defeated while ignited, deals a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

name: Cabbage Weed
desc: A small, seemingly harmless fae. They would have inhabited vegetable gardens, were they not so easily ignited.
abil: Can be ignited by or
When defeated while ignited, deals a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

name: 'Nest'
desc: Fae disguising itself as a fowlbeast nest. When the fowlbeasts flew away, the spirits in the darkness took it over while it was still warm.
abil: Grows when outside your units' Attack Range, increasing its ATK and Max HP

name: 'Cradle'
desc: Fae disguising itself as a fowlbeast nest. A cradle, just the right temperature... and 'hatchlings' breaking from their shells?
abil: Grows when outside your units' Attack Range, increasing its ATK and Max HP

name: Burning Vine
desc: Passionate fae, the fire in its heart like a torch under a strange arch. The flowers and vines wrapping around it are merely decorative.
abil: Attacks inflict additional Burn
ATK continuously increases before its first attack, and the first attack deals a large amount of Arts damage and Burn to the target and surrounding units

name: Burning Wick
desc: Very passionate fae, burning with a even greater desire to consume all uninvited visitors, or consume itself until the last spark becomes a dim ember.
abil: Attacks inflict additional Burn
ATK continuously increases before its first attack, and the first attack deals a large amount of Arts damage and Burn to the target and surrounding units

name: Guiding Sprout
desc: Mischievous fae that leads travelers astray. Not that they do it out of any particular malice—going the wrong way happens all the time outside the Dark Woods too.
abil: Takes root and becomes when on a

name: Guiding Shrub
desc: Bored fae that leads travelers on a path without end. This job has become so familiar to them that it has become mundane.
abil: Takes root and becomes when on a

name: Tree Shield
desc: Stubborn fae that took root, gazing upon the days and nights of travelers straying into the Dark Woods with no way of escape.
abil: Appears when your Operators are deployed in the 4 adjacent tiles around

name: Tree Wall
desc: A silent fae. The path of life is closed. The path of death is closed. All paths are closed.
abil: Appears when your Operators are deployed in the 4 adjacent tiles around

name: Ash Creation
desc: Ember awakened by the Dark Woods. Born in a gust of wind and given a terrible visage by the fae murmurs, it uses its appearance to protect this forest that has accepted it.
abil: Cannot be blocked, and attacks 2 enemies simultaneously
Their true nature is revealed when inside the attack range of your units

name: Ash Artwork
desc: Ember awakened by the Dark Woods. Born in a great fire and shaped by the fae, it has taken many forms—big or small, strong or feeble. Yet its malleability comes only from nature, never nurture.
abil: Cannot be blocked, and attacks 2 enemies simultaneously
Their true nature is revealed when inside the attack range of your units

name: 'End Point'
desc: A fae still learning how to trick people. It disguises itself as the end of the path, or the shape of a cunning tuskbeast. However, it usually misses some crucial detail.
abil: Camouflages itself as an when outside your units' Attack Range

name: 'Middle Point'
desc: A fae adept at tricking people. It appears in the middle of the road or a wrong turn, coaxing people onto the wrong path. The lack of certain details does not compromise the deception.
abil: Camouflages itself as an when outside your units' Attack Range

name: Confused Maintenance Helper
desc: Maintenance Helper whose pathfinding module has been disrupted by Originium. The meal delivery function added by the Engineering Department no longer works. 'You want a repair function? Look, we've already got plenty of engineers. As for Warfarin's food safety warning, we're working on it.'

name: Rampaging Maintenance Helper
desc: Maintenance Helper whose IFF module has been disrupted by Originium. The drill carefully added by the Engineering Department with a safety clutch is now much more dangerous. 'Power output? Look, our priorities are providing our operators with a safe working environment and sufficient moral support, not making this thing do complex work.'

name: Cold Drink Machine
desc: Cold drink machine that has had its trajectory computing module disrupted by Originium. It uncontrollably launches frozen beverage cans at operators who aren't even thirsty at all. Prize winner of the Engineering Department's 10th Ignoble Prize awards. No one can refuse a thoughtful fridge that automatically launches refreshing drinks at you while you work, after all. Just don't think too much about what the medics would say at your next checkup.

name: Hot Drink Machine
desc: Hot drink machine that has had its temperature control module disrupted by Originium. The super-heated drinks it delivers bring physical and psychological trauma. Prize winner of the Engineering Department's 10th Ignoble Prize awards, though it will not be long before the complaints overflow the department's inbox.

name: Worry-Free Cargo Helper
desc: It will brave the chaos and deliver the goods safely to their destination, even when all hell is breaking loose on Rhodes Island. Whether the goods themselves are dangerous is none of its concern.
abil: Flying unit.
Self-destructs immediately when there is an Operator nearby, dealing a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

name: Blast-Proof Cargo Helper
desc: It will brave the chaos and deliver the goods safely to their destination, even when all hell is breaking loose on Rhodes Island. Designed to transport dangerous cargo to begin with, it certainly could not care less whether they are dangerous.
abil: Flying unit.
Self-destructs immediately when there is an Operator nearby, dealing a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

name: 'Frozen Monstrosity's Echo'
desc: Originating from an archived enemy who was once a staunch defender of hearth and home. Originium has recorded and recreated her last waking moment before collapse. She suspects this place of being yet another illusion of the curse, and of her future fate.
abil: When defeated, the tile underneath becomes unavailable for deployment

name: 'Shadow in the Snow'
desc: Originating from an archived enemy who was once a staunch defender of hearth and home. Originium has recorded and recreated her last waking moment before collapse. 'Espy the realm, every life seen; seek your sojourn path.'
abil: When defeated, the tile underneath becomes unavailable for deployment

name: Mockup Auto Meal Distributor
desc: Cafeteria meal distributor that is still in beta testing. A busy operator had the bright idea to attach a maintenance helper to it—to save the effort of walking from the dorms to the cafeteria—but the timing of the test was unfortunate to say the least.
abil: Periodically summons 1

name: Prototype Auto Meal Distributor
desc: Prototype of a cafeteria meal distributor. A busy operator had the bright idea to attach a maintenance helper to it—to save the effort of walking from the dorms to the cafeteria—but the design was overzealous and caused even more trouble.
abil: Periodically summons 1

name: Solidified Originium Colossus
desc: Originating from an archived enemy—an experimental colossus created by spire casters, prone to getting lost. It has appeared in Rhodes Island in a form recreated by solidified Originium.
abil: Attacks deal splash damage

name: Active Originium Colossus
desc: Originating from an archived enemy—an experimental colossus created by spire casters, prone to getting lost. It has appeared in Rhodes Island in a form recreated by dangerous active Originium.
abil: Attacks deal splash damage

name: Stable Sarkaz Caster Crystal
desc: Originating from an archived enemy. The Originium body of these Sarkaz casters has induced unknown changes to the Arts they use, which may pressure our defenses.
abil: Temporarily halts your DP regeneration shortly after it enters the battlefield

name: Active Sarkaz Caster Crystal
desc: Originating from an archived enemy. The Originium body of these Sarkaz casters allows them to use previously unknown forms of Arts to interfere with our deployment, significantly pressuring our defenses.
abil: Temporarily halts your DP regeneration shortly after it enters the battlefield

name: Static Oneiros α
desc: Originating from an archived enemy. It seems unremarkable, but is able to strike before our operators take action. The mechanism by which it does so is unknown.
abil: Flying unit.
Shortly after it enters the battle, throws a bomb to temporarily disable the Operator with the highest DP cost in your Deployment Waiting Zone

name: Static Oneiros β
desc: Originating from an archived enemy. It seems unremarkable, but is able to strike before our operators take action. The mechanism by which it does so is associated with Originium.
abil: Flying unit.
Shortly after it enters the battle, throws a bomb to temporarily disable the Operator with the highest DP cost in your Deployment Waiting Zone

name: Decode Basis α
desc: Unknown entity born in the Abyss. It is passive if not attacked, but appears to be studying our movements.
abil: Does not initially attack; transforms into different forms when certain conditions are met
Transforms into different forms once it has taken 4 Physical attacks, 4 Arts attacks, or if it is blocked

name: Decode Basis β
desc: Unknown entity born in the Abyss. It is passive if not attacked, but appears to be nullifying our attacks.
abil: Does not initially attack; transforms into different forms when certain conditions are met
Transforms into different forms once it has taken 4 Physical attacks, 4 Arts attacks, or if it is blocked

name: 'Wings of the Sankta'
desc: Haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have not yet gotten used to the 'sun' being so close to their heads, so they scatter and flutter in an attempt to shake it off.
abil: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

name: 'Flight of the Sankta'
desc: Haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray, and gotten used to the 'sun' being so close to their heads. They are the aerial extension of faith.
abil: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

name: 'Eyes of the Sankta'
desc: Mutated haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They spend most of their time perched atop the Basilica in bewilderment, unsure which way to look.
abil: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
Attempts to steal 1 Ammo from the target when attacking, and deals heavy Physical damage if attempt is unsuccessful

name: 'Witness of the Sankta'
desc: Mutated haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray and circle above the streets and alleys of the Holy City. They are the Holy City's perception of itself.
abil: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
Attempts to steal 1 Ammo from the target when attacking, and deals heavy Physical damage if attempt is unsuccessful

name: 'Flippers of the Sankta'
desc: Haloed aquatic creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They love desserts, and the way they slap their bellies after a full meal looks like they are praying.
abil: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
[Invitation to Prayer] Temporarily reduces all your units' ASPD

name: 'Pride of the Sankta'
desc: Haloed aquatic creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray, and they invite the slothful to pray with them. They will not take 'no' for an answer.
abil: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
[Invitation to Prayer] Temporarily reduces all your units' ASPD

name: 'Claws of the Sankta'
desc: Haloed terrestrial creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. Empathy has taught these mute creatures the existence of faith, but they do not yet understand it, and often stand still on the street like statues.
abil: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

name: 'Crawl of the Sankta'
desc: Haloed terrestrial creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. Empathy has taught these mute creatures the existence of faith. They have learned to pray and they want to know more. They can often be spotted chasing after confessionals in the city.
abil: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

name: Shrine Swordsman
desc: Selected to patrol the Shrine of Nurtury and ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. Responsible for routine ground patrols. Their combat experience is limited and they are often called upon to clean the shrine's massive milk bottles.
abil: Expends Ammo to permanently increase Movement Speed and ATK. Ammo capacity: 5

name: Elite Shrine Swordsman
desc: Selected to patrol the Shrine of Nurtury and ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. Responsible for routine ground patrols. Their combat experience is considerable and they sometimes help instruct animals that have grown halos.
abil: Expends Ammo to permanently increase Movement Speed and ATK. Ammo capacity: 7

name: Shrine Marksman
desc: Selected to guard key areas of the Shrine of Nurtury and ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They are still unfamiliar with the sniper rifles in their hands, and often accidentally damage the statues of saints on the streets.
abil: Performs extremely long-ranged attacks while holding Ammo. Ammo capacity: 1
Stops and reloads if out of Ammo

name: Elite Shrine Marksman
desc: Selected to guard key areas of the Shrine of Nurtury and ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They have lightning-fast reflexes and are able to track diving haloed fowlbeasts with their scopes.
abil: Performs extremely long-ranged attacks while holding Ammo. Ammo capacity: 1
Stops and reloads if out of Ammo

name: Shrine Nurturer
desc: Nurturers of the Shrine of Nurtury selected to ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They are still unfamiliar with their jobs and often lose Enlightened Pacifiers, or mix up the nurseries of newborn humans and animals.
abil: Periodically restores HP and reloads 1 ammo for 3 nearby enemies

name: Veteran Shrine Nurturer
desc: Nurturers of the Shrine of Nurtury selected to ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They listen to the hearts of pregnant mothers and comfort newly born infants. They mourn every death and give everything for the newborns of Laterano.
abil: Periodically restores HP and reloads 1 ammo for 5 nearby enemies

name: Shrine Preacher
desc: Preachers of the Shrine of Nurtury selected to ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They are firm believers in the Lateran proverb that a good taste for desserts and a full commitment to prayer both start from the cradle.
abil: Locks onto one of your units, continuously dealing Arts damage; continuously reduces the Wakefulness of units that are dreaming

name: Veteran Shrine Preacher
desc: Preachers of the Shrine of Nurtury selected to ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. In addition to the Nativity, they also know everything there is to know about the Laterano outside the shrine. They ensure that everyone accepts the redefinition of Sankta.
abil: Locks onto one of your units, continuously dealing Arts damage; continuously reduces the Wakefulness of units that are dreaming

name: Saint Statue
desc: A saint's statue near the Shrine of Nurtury, modified to ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They have taken over some of the roles held by the executors of the Notarial Hall, but they do not read you the tenets before they shoot you.
abil: Enemies within range gain a Barrier proportionate to their Max HP every second (capped)

name: Praying Saint Statue
desc: A saint's statue near the Shrine of Nurtury, modified to ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. 'May the Law and punishment be with you.'
abil: Enemies within range gain a Barrier proportionate to their Max HP every second (capped)

name: 'Matriarch'
desc: The head of the Shrine of Nurtury, the manifestation of the First Saint in the dream. She has bestowed a halo upon a dying arborbeast fledgling, and borne witness to the miracle of life in Laterano. She said this was the revelation from the Law, showing Laterano how to deal with the calamity.
abil: Attacks 3 enemies simultaneously
Enemies within range gain a Barrier proportionate to their Max HP every second (capped with a higher limit)

name: Audio Technician
desc: A temporary crew member recruited from a Wrankwood studio plate. It is his first movie and he is eager to do his job, but he isn't sure why the mic refuses to record.
abil: When outside the Filming Area, attacks inflict Nervous Impairment

name: Audio Engineer
desc: An experienced crew member who has worked on many films. He knows how to use his boom pole, and thrusts it anywhere he can get sound from.
abil: When outside the Filming Area, attacks inflict Nervous Impairment

name: Zealous Extra
desc: An extra holding a clapperboard and pretending to be part of the crew. He started the shooting with his clapperboard in an attempt to get more screen time. He often improvises in front of the camera, trying to catch people's attention.
abil: Can only be blocked by allied units inside the Filming Area

name: Artistic Extra
desc: An extra holding a clapperboard and pretending to be part of the crew. He is not chasing a dream, just doing it for fun. He likes to hear the audience's screams, caring little about what he is doing in front of the camera.
abil: Can only be blocked by allied units inside the Filming Area

name: Tired Prop Technician
desc: The lighting props are too heavy for even this strong Forte prop technician, who has been crushed by the weight of stress and responsibility. He eagerly seeks any opportunity to take a break.
abil: Places a Lighting Prop on the first empty ground tile within the Filming Area that it passes through

name: Attention-Seeking Prop Technician
desc: It is not rest but attention that this strong Forte prop technician needs. Everything he does in front of the camera catches people's eyes.
abil: Places a Lighting Prop on the first empty ground tile within the Filming Area that it passes through

name: Uneasy Designer
desc: A designer who has missed his deadline. He flees when he finds that he has accidentally entered the shot.
abil: Takes less Physical/Arts damage from the front
Afraid to face the camera. Turns around if facing the camera in the Filming Area
Inflicts Nervous Impairment on blocker when blocked

name: Anguished Designer
desc: A designer who always misses his deadlines. He will do whatever it takes to escape attention when he finds that he has accidentally entered the shot.
abil: Takes less Physical/Arts damage from the front
Afraid to face the camera. Turns around if facing the camera in the Filming Area
Inflicts Nervous Impairment on blocker when blocked

name: Hero's Sidekick
desc: The hero's sidekick. His motto is 'Never say die', and he will fight the villains to the bitter end to ensure the hero's final victory.
abil: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Attack range increases when inside the Filming Area, and prioritizes and
Rebirth

name: Destined Hero
desc: The hero. His motto is 'Never say die', and he will see it done. His special effects sword decapitates his enemies, and he watches their blood spill on the floor with satisfaction while screams fill the set. He will fight to the bitter end.
abil: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Attack range increases when inside the Filming Area, and prioritizes and
Rebirth

name: Villain's Minion
desc: The villain's minion. Its motto is 'Never surrender', and it will fight the heroes to the bitter end to ensure its boss's final victory.
abil: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Attacks hit twice when inside the Filming Area, and prioritizes and

name: Destined Villain
desc: The villain. Its motto is 'Never surrender'. This position is reserved for the strong. It spits out special effects shockwaves and watches with glee as the hero's body is torn to pieces and all traces of his existence erased. It will fight to the bitter end.
abil: Attacks inflict Nervous Impairment.
Attacks hit twice when inside the Filming Area, and prioritizes and

name: Nimble Mannequin
desc: A mannequin that nimbly darts through the set, controlled by the crew's Arts to carry props. It saves time and manpower, but runs into others from time to time.
abil: Unblockable
Deals Physical damage to your units along its path when moving
Unable to move when inside the Filming Area and gains Fragile
Loses a percentage of Max HP each second after spending too much total time in the Filming Area

name: Sentient Mannequin
desc: A mannequin that nimbly darts through the set. Its duty is to transport props. It will do so even when uncommanded, and it will disembowel anyone who stands in its way.
abil: Unblockable
Deals Physical damage to your units along its path when moving
Unable to move when inside the Filming Area and gains Fragile
Loses a percentage of Max HP each second after spending too much total time in the Filming Area

name: Unhappy Cameraman
desc: Cameraman carrying heavy equipment. He is unhappy with his job, and he angrily throws film when a shot goes wrong.
abil: Starts with 5 Film, firing them as ranged attacks. Performs melee attacks when out of Film or blocked

Film explodes when it hits an allied unit or reaches the target location, dealing damage and inflicting Nervous Impairment, and dealing splash damage and inflicting Nervous Impairment on nearby allied units

Film flies much slower when inside the Filming Area

name: Violent Cameraman
desc: Cameraman carrying heavy equipment. He is unhappy with everything, and has already angrily thrown film at whoever is nearest.
abil: Starts with 5 Film, firing them as ranged attacks. Performs melee attacks when out of Film or blocked

Film explodes when it hits an allied unit or reaches the target location, dealing damage and inflicting Nervous Impairment, and dealing splash damage and inflicting Nervous Impairment on nearby allied units

Film flies much slower when inside the Filming Area

name: 'Certain Fates'
desc: The size of a fingertip, the weight of a murmur of fate and inertia. It does not intend to destroy, not even to arrive. It only follows the shortest path of inevitability and the longest path of coincidence, spinning and moving forward. In its own time, the world is simply walls to collide with, propositions to bounce off, cacophonous and silent.
abil: Gain 'Favor' when it collides with an enemy
Disappears when it stops moving
Disappears after a while

name: 'Certain Fates'
desc: The size of a fingertip, the weight of a murmur of fate and inertia. It does not intend to destroy, not even to arrive. It only follows the shortest path of inevitability and the longest path of coincidence, spinning and moving forward. In its own time, the world is simply walls to collide with, propositions to bounce off, cacophonous and silent. The most glancing impact is enough to make life and chaos collide with each other.
abil: Gain 'Favor' when it collides with an enemy
Disappears when it stops moving
Disappears after a while

name: Careless Underling
desc: A Kinsekikai underling who goes into deep self-doubt if he falls, stopping to philosophize about his own existence. That is why he remains an underling.
abil: Becomes temporarily stunned when shifted

name: Veteran Underling
desc: A veteran Kinsekikai underling who has fallen many times and gotten back up, but still cannot help but philosophize about his own existence and if he is suited to this line of work. That is why he remains an underling, despite his experience.
abil: Becomes temporarily stunned when shifted

name: Raiton Ninja
desc: A ninja who loves technology, wielding a kendama-shaped flash drive as a weapon. Unbound by anyone, they leap to avoid danger.
abil: Briefly takes off when colliding with <'Certain Fates'>, blocked, or encountering a Hole.

name: Raiton Master
desc: A ninja obsessed with technology, wielding a kendama-shaped flash drive filled with deadly spam. Completely unbound by anyone, they quickly leap to avoid danger.
abil: Briefly takes off when colliding with <'Certain Fates'>, blocked, or encountering a Hole.

name: Pessimistic Oath-Brother
desc: A shield-wielding elite Kinsekikai bruiser who believes that life is a constant cycle of losing one's balance and starting over.
abil: Has Barrier, and loses Barrier when shifted
DEF is reduced when Barrier is lost

name: Desperate Oath-Brother
desc: An elite Kinsekikai bruiser obsessed with his shield, which seems to have a habit of abandoning him when he needs it the most, leaving him in despair.
abil: Has Barrier, and loses Barrier when shifted
DEF is reduced when Barrier is lost

name: Doton Ninja
desc: An introverted ninja disguising himself as a hole. He may look ridiculous, but he is harder to detect than you might expect.
abil: When on the battlefield, has Invisibility and disguises as a Hole
Becomes hostile after losing Invisibility or absorbing <'Certain Fates'>
