name: Heroic Spirit
desc: An illusion created by the stories of the aoidoi. Heroic spirit comes in a million forms—no task is too enormous for a hero, if they shoulder their responsibility.
abil: Not affected by Immersed
Dodges Physical and Arts damage from your non-Immersed units

name: Handmade Catapult
desc: Catapult handmade from cardboard by Minoan citizens, limiting its power. It has been loaded with too many rocks, making bringing it to its destination an exhausting task and hampering its accuracy as the operator's hand is usually shaking from fatigue by the time it is actually used.
abil: Attacks hit 3 times and deal physical splash damage
Aim deviates randomly when Immersed

name: Refurbished Lithobolos
desc: Stone thrower from the city-state era, repurposed for use in theater. Classical architecture and modern buildings blend together on the streets of Minos, as do relics from the classical period, gaining new life in the hands of modern Minoans. It remains heavy, however, and the operator's hand still shakes.
abil: Attacks hit 3 times and deal physical splash damage
Aim deviates randomly when Immersed

name: Palladulis
desc: The hero Palladulis, played by two Minoans. Palladulis always led the charge from the front in Minos's war of liberation, making him one of the most popular of the Twelve Heroes. One person is insufficient to recreate his heroism, so the role is traditionally played by two.
abil: Charges if there is an ally in the direction of its movement, dealing heavy Physical damage when it hits your unit
When Immersed, charge passes through allies until hitting terrain, taking heavy True damage and becoming stunned

name: Brave Palladulis
desc: The hero Palladulis, played by two Minoans. They have become experts at playing Palladulis, working in perfect tandem to recreate his heroic charge. The one in front has gotten used to getting dazed from hitting walls, as the one in back cannot see what is in front of them.
abil: Charges if there is an ally in the direction of its movement, dealing heavy Physical damage when it hits your unit
When Immersed, charge passes through allies until hitting terrain, taking heavy True damage and becoming stunned

name: Matters of Money
desc: Scriptgeist born of the beautiful wishes of the people, whose original name was 'Money'. In the Great Hunt a thousand years ago, the wealthy gave their wealth, and the poor their strength, joining forces to defeat the might of heaven. Historians recorded this for posterity and archived it in Sky Mirror Pavilion.
abil: Friendly Unit
Grants DP when entering the Objective Point

name: Matters of Cooking
desc: Scriptgeist born of the fire and smoke of kitchens, whose original name was 'Food'. In the Great Hunt a thousand years ago, the people worked their kitchens around the clock to supply the soldiers with food, giving them the courage to fight. Historians recorded this for posterity and archived it in Sky Mirror Pavilion.
abil: Friendly Unit
Provides SP to friendly Operators when approaching them, then disappears

name: Wield Arms
desc: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. The smoke dissipates and the broken armor sinks into the sand, as the bleached bones hope to return in spring.
abil: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

name: Wield Arms - Oppress
desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. Swords and spears lie buried, and tears of blood have stopped flowing. The bleached bones shall know spring no more.
abil: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

name: Draw Bow
desc: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Bow. The histories write: 'Where does the bowstring return, across thousands of miles to the Pass?' Every goodbye on that bridge was solemn and earnest. The wind stirs the sand, the long bow a full moon; listen to the string ring, and hope for its bearer's return.
abil: Hits 3 times
Prioritizes attacking allies on Glyph Tiles

name: Draw Bow - Screech
desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Bow'. The histories write: 'Where does the bowstring return, across thousands of miles to the Pass?' Every goodbye on that bridge was solemn and earnest. The sandstorm rages, and the bowstring wails, yet its bearer is nowhere to be seen, but for the lingering echoes of the string's ring.
abil: Hits 3 times
Prioritizes attacking allies on Glyph Tiles

name: Uproot Mountain
desc: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Strength'. The histories write: 'Cold wind howls, for the brave never returned.' Their names are forgotten to history, but their legacies remain in a nation secure. So long as their strength holds, the way home shall be found.
abil: Damage from Stamp reduced
When on a Glyph Tile, disables stamp effects for all glyphs on current tile and all connected Glyph Tiles

name: Uproot Mountain - Overshadow
desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Strength'. The histories write: 'Cold wind howls, for the brave never returned.' Their names are forgotten to history, and the nation is not yet secure. Even as their strength holds, they shall never find their way home.
abil: Damage from Stamp reduced
When on a Glyph Tile, disables stamp effects for all glyphs on current tile and all connected Glyph Tiles

name: Raise Tide
desc: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Brush'. At the end of the history book is a comment in light-colored ink: 'Spring and autumn know me, and I shall fear not the long night.' The writer believes that right and wrong will become apparent by the historian's brush.
abil: Writes the glyph Soldier when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

name: Raise Tide - Summon
desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Brush'. At the end of the history book is a comment in dried ink: 'Spring and autumn are not me. How could they know how long the night is?' If history can be altered, and writing forged, who will seek justice for the innumerable souls lost to the ages?
abil: Writes the glyph Soldier when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

name: Ride Tide
desc: Scriptgeist born from the brush of a great calligrapher, whose original name was 'Book'. 'Adversity births the chronicle; Darkness completes the tome.' The writings that expose stories of injustice will become the torch that guides those who are to come.
abil: Writes the glyph Friend when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

name: Ride Tide - Return
desc: Scriptgeist born from the brush of a great calligrapher, whose original name was 'Book'. 'Adversity births the chronicle; Darkness completes the tome.' The writings that expose stories of injustice will become the torch that lights the way home for the indomitable souls in the great river of history.
abil: Writes the glyph Friend when first entering an empty Glyph Tile

name: Ribbon in the Waves
desc: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Falsehood'. 'He who claims himself pure should be cast into murky waters.' Purity and corruption, truth and falsehood, are never decided by the fins swimming in the river.
abil: Can move through empty Glyph Tiles
Exits glyph form when stamped by a Stamp, becoming stunned, and cannot turn back to glyph form for a while
Cannot be teleported

name: Ribbon in the Waves - Rust
desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Falsehood'. 'He who claims himself pure should be cast into murky waters.' Purity and corruption, truth and falsehood, are never easy to tell. Who can tell if the words of the swimming fins are true?
abil: Can move through empty Glyph Tiles
Exits glyph form when stamped by a Stamp, becoming stunned, and cannot turn back to glyph form for a while
Cannot be teleported

name: Thief in the Clouds
desc: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Thief'. At the end of the history book is a comment in light-colored ink: 'The thief stole the ink, and sundered spring and autumn.' The writer understands it well. It is not easy to write with honesty and integrity, but history will never be forgotten, so long as those who write continue to do so.
abil: Flying unit.
Steals the first glyph encountered after a delay, losing Movement Speed

name: Thief in the Clouds - Erode
desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Thief'. At the end of the history book is a comment in dried colored ink: 'The thief stole the ink, and sundered spring and autumn.' The writer's brush stops. How could one brush hope to stand against oblivion itself?
abil: Flying unit.
Steals the first glyph encountered after a delay, losing Movement Speed

name: Frost Play
desc: The work of 'White'. Invade and advance at the same time, relying not on advantage, nor placing oneself in disadvantage. 'Honor is vice; deceit is virtue.'
abil: Becomes the glyph Broken when stamped, sealing its Glyph Tile

name: Frost Play - Fight
desc: The work of 'White'. Like jade and gem complementing each other, like the stars illuminating the heavens. 'Honor is vice; deceit is virtue.'
abil: Becomes the glyph Broken when stamped, sealing its Glyph Tile

name: 'White'
desc: A nightmare born of the void of 'evolution'. Long has it hidden in the shadows, but now it takes its place at the board.
abil: Invulnerable
Summons and to affect the game

name: Chun
desc: 'The elf who wanders a thousand realms, the fire that illuminates the long night, the visitor lost in the past, the lingerer who reminisces on the departed.'
abil: Immune to most control effects when using a skill
[Unsubmerged] After Stamp hits, stops moving and continuously absorbs , , and , gaining barrier whenever one is successfully absorbed
[Opening Statement] Selects the nearest 'Soldier' Glyph Tile, then after a short delay stamps it once along with each connected Glyph Tile
Revives when HP drops to 0 for the first time, writes the Friend glyph on the two furthest Glyph Tiles, and immediately activates Stamp

name: 'Unquenched'
desc: Sui's wrath. Go forth and face Its wrath head-on, if you are prepared to never return.
abil: When ignited by [Wrath of Eons], deals Arts damage to your surrounding units

name: Duck Lord
desc: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abil: Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

name: Gopnik
desc: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

name: Crying Thief
desc: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.
abil: Invisible
Attacks Stun the target

name: Fatty
desc: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
abil: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

name: Little Ba'jie
desc: A mascot for the Garden of Grotesqueries that Yi made himself, transformed into a geist from the adoration of visitors. One of the few geists not under the supervision of the Sui Regulator or Tianshi Bureaus. It spends its days interacting with visitors at the souvenir shop, or playing with ritual processions on the days when the garden is closed.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
After receiving a certain number of hits, deals Arts damage to all allied units in a large area and stuns them

name: Derisive Audience
desc: A diehard fan of the Crimson Troupe, they enjoy the performances night and day. They have become as incomprehensible as the troupe itself.
abil: Attacks inflict additional Nervous Impairment

name: Scarlet Singer
desc: A performer of the Crimson Troupe, they unleash their singing voices when sufficiently stimulated, inciting their followers to attack in a frenzy.
abil: Attacks inflict additional Nervous Impairment
After receiving a certain number of hits, greatly increases all enemies' ASPD for a short period

name: Theater Golem
desc: A gigantic golem maintained by the Crimson Troupe's prop department, they are normally used to move bulky items. They are massive and difficult to block.
abil: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
Attacks deal Splash damage to allied units in a small area around self

name: 'Small Surprise'
desc: A special gift prepared by the Crimson Troupe for the audience. Every audience member who receives a gift will become particularly 'ecstatic'.
abil: Flying unit.
Upon death, deals Arts damage to all surrounding units and inflicts Nervous Impairment

name: Ominous Apparition
desc: A patch of shadow. It has never once left, nor has it ever truly existed.
abil: Has a chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks when not blocked
Can use a skill to deal Physical damage in the surrounding area
Attacks and skills ignore a certain amount of armor and inflict additional Nervous Impairment

name: Bone Sea Drifter
desc: Sea Terrors travel in large swarms, seeking carcasses to feast on and becoming food for other Sea Terrors themselves.
abil: Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.

name: Ocean Stonecutter
desc: Sea Terror with a hard shell, protecting the swarm from enemies.
abil: When your units enter its attack range for the first time, temporarily stops moving and gains increased DEF.

name: Retching Broodmother
desc: Sea Terror mothers that throw fake offspring at oncoming threats, allowing the true offspring to flee.
abil: Can only attack ground targets
Summons 1 near the target when dealing damage

name: Baleful Broodling
desc: An extension of the broodmother's body, identical to newly-born offspring.
abil: Unable to move
Gradually loses HP over time
Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.

name: Skimming Sea Drifter
desc: Some Sea Terrors have begun to adapt to the sky, able to glide above the waves for extended periods. Perhaps this branch will eventually evolve to make their home in the heavens.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.

name: Pathshaper Fractal
desc: Fractals left behind by the Seaborn Pathshaper. Illusions must eventually vanish. The path is not clear. Search on, search on.
abil: Dies after some time
Every 3rd attack summons a

name: Ishar'mla's Tears
desc: Manifestation of Ishar'mla's explorative and combative nature.
abil: Appears around your units
Periodically deals True damage. If there are no targets within attack range, charges up
Disappears when transforms

name: Izumik's Offspring
desc: One of Izumik's evolutionary branches, bringing genetic data collected across Terra back to the mother.
abil: Becomes a random enemy when blocked.

name: Chest Seaborn
desc: Sea Terror disguised as a treasure chest, often used by Bishops of the Deep to protect hideouts.

name: Tainted Carcass
desc: A Sami warrior irreversibly corrupted by demons. He once went to the snow fields with a clear purpose, but is now completely bereft.
abil: Movement Speed significantly increases for a short time after taking damage

name: Distorted Caster
desc: A Sami shaman possessed by demons. Everything they understood about nature has been reconstructed into pure nothingness.
abil: Movement Speed significantly increases after not attacking for a period of time, resets on attack

name: Collapsed Construct
desc: A drone corrupted by demonic power, now acting like a real lifeform.
abil: Flying unit.

name: Shattered Champion
desc: Once an honorable warrior of the Treescar tribe, now a part of the demons' vanguard, together with their fallen chief.

name: Testaceous Vinecreeps
desc: A seed falls into a box abandoned in the wild, and soon becomes a hunter preying on curiosity.

name: Khaganshadow
desc: A soul trapped in the Khagan Nightzmora, which will raise its weapon and follow its eternal general to the ends of the land.

name: Royal Companion
desc: The proud Beast Stewards have long had close ties to Sargon royalty, some even choosing to serve by a king's side as guardian.

name: Sarkaz Maze Guide
desc: A Lich who was once a custodian of the Temple of Knowledge, now lost to the illusions of the furnace for times unknown. He may hail from a Kazdel different from the one you know.
abil: Extends the duration of the current Epoch upon entering the Objective.

name: Sarkaz Maze Returner
desc: A Wendigo warrior bound by a promise to his homeland. The heavy tombstone on his back, engraved with the names of his kindred, has often forced him to his knees, but even more often compelled him to rise.
abil: Attacks hit 2 times when on a Mark of Epoch.

name: Dreadkaz
desc: Born neither from Sarkaz soul nor blood, yet it can deprive both. It is an enigmatic impostor, an unknown plague, a latent curse. It must not be released.
abil: When spawned, deals Arts damage to all allied units around its tile and creates a temporary Mark of Epoch.

name: Sarkaz Maze Spellweaver
desc: A vigilant Lich, one of the many custodians of the Temple of Knowledge. His threads entwine with the sparks in the Soul Furnace, rescuing unwitting wanderers and punishing trespassers.
abil: Stops attacking and starts channeling to create Marks of Epoch around the Objective.

name: 'Portal'
desc: A portal that follows the living and can occasionally be encountered in the Furnace. Do not fear if it compels you to enter, for it has already prepared an exit.
abil: Temporarily removes an Operator from the squad when it disappears.

name: Holy Automaton
desc: Automaton protecting the Holy City. It can execute its built-in sacrificial ritual to unleash a powerful holy shockwave, commonly known by some Sarkaz as 'self-destruction.'
abil: Cannot be blocked.
Movement Speed gradually increases. Deals Physical damage to all units upon entering the Objective.

name: Lost Contraption
desc: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. It has continuously operated for so long that its movements have become slow and haphazard.
abil: Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

name: Lost Hovercraft
desc: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. Despite its ability to hover for extended periods, its built-in package protection mechanism compels it to land immediately upon encountering interference.
abil: Low-Altitude Hovering
Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

name: Padmasana of Rebirth
desc: It has no bottom yet never leaks, ferrying passengers from all lands to greener pastures atop a bed of cerulean flames. Only the freed may board this ark.
abil: Loads up to 3 allied Operators upon contact. Movement speed is reduced when loaded.
Will not deduct Life Points when entering the Objective Point; loaded allied Operators cannot be placed on the field

name: 'Window'
desc: A solitary window, manifested from all that is bright and beautiful within the dark void. Find the strength to open it, and you will behold prosperity beyond your wildest dreams.
abil: Upon defeating the 'Window', the player will enter Prosperity

name: Finale Cadence
desc: The only way to the end.
abil: Drops a random Collectible when it enters the Protection Objective; Remaining HP carries over to the next operation

name: Talisman
desc: Paper talisman seen throughout the Garden of Grotesqueries, with various messages written on them: Timetables, notes, tips, prohibitions... Endowed with meaning by the hand of man, it stubbornly refuses to leave anyone that it sticks to.
abil: Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks
When attached to a target, deals Arts damage every second and prevents them from using skills

name: Shadow Scholar
desc: A character often seen in Yanese shadow plays, prone to strange encounters in those plays. This Shadowgeist has seen these scenes play out so many times that it believes them to be real, and even warning of the talismans is not enough to dissuade it.
abil: When HP drops below a certain level, absorbs a nearby and recovers HP

name: Bottle Swordsman
desc: Once a wandering physician's medicine bottle, it provided healing to many warriors. When it became a geist, it was moved by a talisman and put the talisman in its bottle, embarking on a journey of chivalry.
abil: Starts with 3 ; attacks attach a to the target when carrying a

name: Mirror Tianshi
desc: A well-polished mirror that believes it sees everything clearly. When it became a Geist, it was not content with just seeing things, but could not stop itself from giving unsolicited advice, just like the old scholars in the Tianshi Bureau.
abil: Picks a target from very long range, dealing Arts damage and sending a

name: Pseudomut
desc: Similar in appearance to a Feranmut, it looks like an ancient 'God', but it is no more than a mere beast. It has become extinct in modern times, for its greed never diminished, despite no longer having the reputation of the Feranmuts to draw from.
abil: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker and gains Low-Altitude Hovering
Returns devoured Operator when defeated

name: Strange Gourd
desc: A gourd that turned into a geist, with an incessant desire for hoarding despite not being particularly active. When disturbed, it tries to draw everything around it into its interior.
abil: Strange Gourd gains increased HP and ATK based on the amount of Originium Ingots owned
Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

name: Liang
desc: Created by Yi to handle various mundane matters, so that he may live in seclusion without being interrupted by official matters.
abil: Explodes upon death, dealing Arts damage to friendly units. Causes even greater damage and stuns friendly units if similar units of the opposite attribute are in its vicinity
Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks

name: Hateful Carrion
desc: Under the influence of the tomb's host, these inanimate objects have gained vessels just like It, and a life of their own. The Sui Regulator has termed such changes 'geistification'.
abil: Deals Arts damage

name: Restrained Pride
desc: The tail was born to be a blade, which men take to be a sword. Once, It let Its arrogance run unchecked. Now, It knows to conceal the blade.
abil: Aerial unit.
Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Physical damage

name: Fume of Anger
desc: All that came to be because It saw the fire must end in fire.
abil: Aerial unit.
Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Arts damage and inflicting Burn

name: Retrofitted Gastruck
desc: A pesticide spraying vehicle that used to belong to a large nomadic city. It has been retrofitted by Closure to spray tear gas instead, but she didn't have time to install an IFF system.
abil: When unblocked, all allied units lose HP constantly

name: Supercharged Gastruck
desc: A pesticide spraying vehicle that used to belong to a large nomadic city. It has been retrofitted by Closure to spray tear gas instead, but she didn't have time to install an IFF system. This model has an expanded gas tank and is far more dangerous.
abil: When unblocked, all allied units lose HP constantly

name: Cheap Second-hand Drone
desc: Cheap goods sold for scrap from the Kazimierz arenas. Feel free to waste it however you like.
abil: Flying unit.
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

name: Remodeled Second-hand Drone
desc: Cheap goods sold for scrap from the Kazimierz arenas. Closure has performed some slight modifications on this batch, but it won't change the fact these are cheap as hell.
abil: Flying unit.
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

name: Mobile Power Source
desc: An experimental prototype developed during the early years of a certain Columbian tech company. The objective was to provide power on the battlefield, however due to the lack of a positioning device, it will often leave by itself if unattended to.
abil: Cannot be blocked.
When destroyed, recovers the SP of nearby Operators
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

name: Supply Wagon
desc: Logistics would soon realize that Engineering's latest supply wagon is a little too... eccentric to transport soda bottles. It has been repurposed to toss exploding soda bottles on the racecourse.
abil: Cannot be blocked.
Throws exploding soda bottles, dealing True damage around itself (including to itself).

name: 'Soda POP!' Supply Wagon
desc: Logistics has realized that Engineering's latest supply wagon is a little too... eccentric to transport soda bottles. It has been repurposed to toss exploding soda bottles on the racecourse, an explosive race the likes of which has never been seen.
abil: Cannot be blocked.
Throws exploding soda bottles, dealing True damage around itself (including to itself).

name: Musbeast Supplier
desc: The Musbeast Supplier likes to carry an oversized supply box on one paw as it scurries around the racecourse. It does so because it thinks it's super strong, and because it can do this, it believes it's super strong.
abil: Chance to drop its supply box when taking damage.
HP depletes over time when it loses its supply box.

name: 'Big Brawn' Musbeast Supplier
desc: The Musbeast Supplier likes to carry an oversized supply box on one paw and flex its biceps as it scurries around the racecourse. It does so because it thinks it's super strong, and because it can do this, it believes it's super strong.
abil: Chance to drop its supply box when taking damage.
HP depletes over time when it loses its supply box.

name: Sandbeast Supplier
desc: Logistics belatedly realized that sighting one sandbeast often means the presence of a dozen. They have been trained to serve as suppliers now, but there is always the risk of tripping over the supplies they scatter all over the place.
abil: Restores a large amount of HP to all nearby enemies but itself when it takes a certain amount of damage.

name: 'Faircare' Sandbeast Supplier
desc: Logistics belatedly realized that sighting one sandbeast often means the presence of a dozen. They have been trained to serve as suppliers now, but the medical room is filled with competitors who tripped over the supplies they scattered all over the place.
abil: Restores a large amount of HP to all nearby enemies but itself when it takes a certain amount of damage.

name: Burdenbeast Supplier
desc: No one understands the danger of the Rhodes Island arena better than a Burdenbeast Supplier. When it saw a ball hit by an Operator's claymore smash through the arena's wall, it couldn't help but cry out, 'Moo, moo!'
abil: Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
Always faces the side where you have more units.

name: 'Timidthy' Burdenbeast Supplier
desc: No one understands the danger of the Rhodes Island arena better than a Burdenbeast Supplier. When it saw a ball hit by an Operator's claymore smash through the arena's wall, it's urgent moos must have meant, 'Please save me, God of Burdenbeasts!'
abil: Damage from the front is greatly reduced.
Always faces the side where you have more units.

name: Hammer Supplier
desc: It is unusual, but not unheard of, to be injured when an arena cleaning cart runs over your toes. Things become somewhat surreal when there's an adorable beast on the cart eager to whoop you with a squeaky hammer.
abil: Performs 5 heavy blows with greatly increased ATK. An attack that defeats a unit does not use up a count.
When out of attack counts, cannot attack and takes significantly more damage for some time.

name: 'Rampage' Hammer Supplier
desc: It is unusual, but not unheard of, to be injured when an arena cleaning cart runs over your toes. Things become somewhat scary when there's an adorable beast on the cart trying to whoop you for no reason with a squeaky hammer.
abil: Performs 5 heavy blows with greatly increased ATK. An attack that defeats a unit does not use up a count.
When out of attack counts, cannot attack and takes significantly more damage for some time.

name: Ironhead Forward
desc: The Ironhead Forward is known for his headdown tackles, headlong rushes, and headstrong nature.
abil: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].

name: 'Charger' Ironhead Forward
desc: The Ironhead Forward has his own motto: Find a heading, and head there headfirst.
abil: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].

name: Long-Armed Pitcher
desc: A once-in-a-generation pitcher who was born to throw. Ordinary ballgames have lost their appeal; he prefers the thrill of throwing at people.
abil: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].
Prioritizes attacking units on [Foldable Bastions].
Cannot be blocked.

name: 'True Shot' Long-Armed Pitcher
desc: A once-in-a-generation pitcher who was born to throw. His grandfather once served in Gaul's grenadier battalion, so it's no wonder that he enjoys throwing at people.
abil: Deals more damage to [Foldable Bastion].
Prioritizes attacking units on [Foldable Bastions].
Cannot be blocked.

name: Field Shooter
desc: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away.
abil: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

name: 'Longshot' Field Shooter
desc: This musbeast was recruited as shooter under the reasoning that if it can leap high, it can kick a ball very, very far away. I mean really far away.
abil: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

name: Field Goalie
desc: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there.
abil: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

name: 'Brain Barrier' Field Goalie
desc: This burdenbeast was recruited as goalkeeper under the reasoning that its head is so big that it can block the goal just by standing there. There is even the off-chance that it catches the ball between its horns.
abil: Prioritizes attacking the football towards your goal.

name: Field Bludgeoner
desc: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't do it, swing again.
abil: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

name: 'Basher' Field Bludgeoner
desc: Can't lose if the opponent has no players left. If one swing doesn't... Nah, one swing always does it.
abil: Prioritizes attacking your Operators.

name: RMA70 Spikeball
desc: A football that imitates RMA70 minerals to enrich the match experience. Its spikes are surprisingly benign. Players who have tried it say that kicking it is a highly interactive experience.
abil: A standard football.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

name: Fluffy Pink Balloon
desc: A football that imitates a furry critter to enrich the match experience... Hey, where did it go? Okay, it's actually a real furry critter that's drifting through the air right now.
abil: A very light football that can be easily moved.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

name: Compressed Ball
desc: A football made from compressed building materials to enrich the match experience. 'Heavy' doesn't begin to describe it. Do your foot a favor and don't bother kicking it.
abil: A heavy football that is hard to move.
Can only be blocked by a Goalkeeper or unit with Block Count of 3 or higher.

name: Infused Originium Ball

Capable of boosting plant growth and Originium Slug reproduction by dispersing its pollen, it can even fly slowly in the air. Some scholars believe that its ability to fly is new evidence of unintelligent organisms actively manipulating complex Originium Arts, while others believe it is nothing more than a naturally occurring phenomenon under hyper-specific conditions. This question has yet to be resolved, as no biologist has been desperate enough to approach it.
